title: Towards understanding and monitorability of reasoning LLMs
title_zh: 关于推理大语言模型的可理解性与可监控性
abstract: Frontier LLMs are trained to solve problems in a step-by-step way, generating reasoning text in human-understandable language. However, these reasoning tokens are not accurate explanations of LLMs’ internal computations, raising challenges for monitorability.
abstract_zh: 前沿大语言模型被训练为逐步解决问题，生成人类可理解的推理文本。然而，这些推理token并非大语言模型内部计算的准确解释，这给可监控性带来了挑战。
